actions.addOrUpdateContact.description: Creates a contact, or updates it when it matches an existing one.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.affilia: The affiliate/referer partner through which the contact signed up.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.assigne: Preferably, Sperse User Email should be passed as it is unique within Sperse account but User Name can be also passed
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.channel: The channel/medium the contact used to find your website.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.company: Name of the contact's company. Required if First Name, Last Name and email fields are empty.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.contact: ChargeKeep contact ID of an existing contact to update. Leave empty to match by email and name, or to create a new contact.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.dob.des: Valid date format YYYY-MM-DD or MM-DD-YYYY.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.entryUr: The first page of visit through which the contact visited your website.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.firstNa: Required if Last Name, Company Name and email fields are empty.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.followU: Valid date format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. If date is defined then new Follow Up Task will be created for this contact
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.fullNam: The contact's full name. Used to fill First Name and Last Name when both are empty.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.lastNam: Required if First Name, Company Name and email fields are empty.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.leadSou: The first known source the contact used to find your website. You can set this automatically and update manually later.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.matchEx: If "Yes", will try to find an existing record using Email and Full Name and update it.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.namePre: The title used to address the contact.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.nameSuf: Additional information about the contact e.g PhD.
actions.addOrUpdateContact.props.referer: The webpage where the contact clicked a link that sent them to your website.
The contact's full street address (can include apartment or unit number).
actions.addOrUpdateSubscription.descript: Adds a product subscription to a contact, or replaces the existing one for that product.
actions.addOrUpdateSubscription.props.co: ChargeKeep contact ID. Required unless External Contact ID is set.
Your external reference (XREF) for the contact. Required unless Contact ID is set.
actions.addOrUpdateSubscription.props.pa: The chosen Period Type has to be set for the Product on the ChargeKeep side.
actions.addOrUpdateSubscription.props.pr: Product Code (SKU) of an existing subscription product.
Optional. Product Code is used to find the product.
actions.createInvoice.description: Creates a new invoice in the CRM.
actions.createInvoice.props.amount.descr: Payment amount. Leave empty to create the invoice without recording a payment.
actions.createInvoice.props.contactId.de: ChargeKeep contact ID. Required unless External Contact ID is set.
Your external reference (XREF) for the contact. Required unless Contact ID is set.
actions.createInvoice.props.grandTotal.d: Defaults to the line total plus shipping and tax, minus discount.
actions.createInvoice.props.historicalDa: Pass true if the payment is not an actual transaction (historical record). Only used when Amount is set.
actions.createInvoice.props.invoiceNo.de: Unique invoice number, e.g. INV-1001. Reusing a number updates that invoice.
Product Code. We will look up the product
actions.createInvoice.props.transactionD: Date of the payment. Defaults to now. Only used when Amount is set.
actions.createProduct.description: Creates a product in the CRM, or updates the product with the same SKU.
actions.createProduct.props.customPeriod: Number of periods when the Payment Cycle is Custom or OneTime.
Period type when the Payment Cycle is Custom.
actions.createProduct.props.cycles.descr: Number of billing cycles (Subscription products). Leave empty for no limit.
actions.createProduct.props.descriptionH: Javascript and media tags are not allowed
actions.createProduct.props.fee.descript: Fee per cycle. Required for Subscription products.
actions.createProduct.props.frequency.de: Payment cycle for Subscription products. Defaults to Monthly.
actions.createProduct.props.gracePeriodD: Grace period in days after a missed payment (Subscription products).
actions.createProduct.props.price.descri: One-time price. Required for General, Digital and Event products.
actions.createProduct.props.trialDayCoun: Free trial length in days (Subscription products).
actions.createProduct.props.unit.descrip: Price unit for General, Digital and Event products. Defaults to Unit.
actions.create_invoice.description: Create an invoice with one or more lines, or update the invoice with the same number.
Defaults to the sum of line totals plus shipping and tax, minus discount.
actions.create_invoice.props.historicalP: yes when the payment is a past record, not a live transaction. Defaults to no.
actions.create_invoice.props.lines.descr: Array of {productCode, description, quantity, rate, total, unitId}.
actions.create_invoice.props.paymentAmou: Records a payment of this amount on the invoice.
actions.create_invoice.props.status.desc: Draft, Final, Sent or Paid. Defaults to Draft.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.getContactDetails.description: Get a contact by ID, XREF, affiliate code, user ID or user email.
actions.getContactDetails.props.userEmai: Email of the logged in user
actions.getContactDetails.props.userId.d: Id of the logged in user (not contact id)
actions.list_contact_groups.description: List the contact groups (Client, Partner, ...) of the account.
actions.list_products.description: Find products by name or SKU.
actions.search_contacts.description: Find contacts by name, email or phone.
actions.upsert_contact.description: Create a contact, or update it when it matches an existing one.
actions.upsert_contact.props.assignedUse: Email of the ChargeKeep user to assign.
actions.upsert_contact.props.contactId.d: ID of an existing contact to update.
actions.upsert_contact.props.contactType: Lead, Client or Partner. Defaults to Lead.
actions.upsert_contact.props.contactXref: Your external ID for the contact; sending it again updates the same contact.
actions.upsert_contact.props.customField: Object with keys customField1 to customField5.
actions.upsert_contact.props.matchExisti: Match an existing contact by email and name. Defaults to true.
auth.description:
To get your ChargeKeep API key:

1. Sign in to https://crm.chargekeep.com (or https://beta.chargekeep.com) with an admin account.
2. Open the admin settings and find the API keys page.
3. Create a key and paste it below. Pick the Base URL of the site you signed in to.
